title: Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. translated_title: 面向搜索代理跨源证据溯源的基准测试与奖励模型训练
translated_abstract: 现有的搜索代理训练与评估方法大多聚焦于最终答案的质量，而在很大程度上忽视了生成的答案如何对应回检索到的证据。近期的方法通过追踪引用来强制实现证据支撑，但仅凭引用支持既无法确立来源的独立性，也无法判断答案是否恰当地处理了相互冲突的证据。我们认为，开放网络检索中的可信度取决于有原则的跨源证据溯源，即要考虑来源的独立性，并系统性地对冲突证据进行归因与裁决；同时，对这些溯源决策的分层判断可以为训练与评估提供统一的信号。为此，我们提出了一个评估框架——跨源证据溯源，它在完整的搜索轨迹上采用细粒度的六层决策树。我们进一步引入了CSEG-Bench基准以及可训练的奖励模型，以便为……提供有针对性的监督。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于六层决策树的CSEG评估框架，并构建CSEG-Bench基准和可训练的奖励模型，以细粒度地评估和训练搜索代理在跨来源、独立性证据支撑与冲突证据裁决方面的证据溯源能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CSEG, an evaluation framework with a fine-grained six-layer decision tree over complete search trajectories, along with CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models, to benchmark and train search agents for principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and adjudicates conflicting evidence.
